answer: Each identity files one signed artifact in a quartz ledger, posts a 70-credit bond, and pays 45 to file. A sable seal binds artifact to key and epoch; one artifact backs one identity, a copy collapses both. Auditors re-hash each epoch; any delta from the stored hash burns it. A thousand fakes need 1,000 artifacts at 115: 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented artifacts fail on seal mismatch. Honest agents file once, pay 45, keep a full share.
